text: 金十数据9月30日讯，A股三大股指早盘高开后震荡下挫，截至中午收盘，沪指涨0.27%，深证成指跌0.06%，创业板指跌0.17%；沪深两市半日成交额9093亿，较上个交易日放量331亿。全市场超2600只个股上涨。盘面上，房地产板块走出V型反弹，陆家嘴、深物业A、中天服务涨停，滨江集团、信达地产、深深房A 、万科A、招商蛇口跟涨。CRO概念领涨，康希诺20CM涨停，昭衍新药、南华生物、蔚蓝生物、美诺华涨停。粮食概念回暖，亚联发展涨停，登海种业、万向德农涨超5%。存储芯片板块、PCB概念、MLCC概念、CPO板块跌幅居前，澳弘电子、华瓷股份跌停。培育钻石板
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 30 - The three major A-share indices opened higher in the morning but then fluctuated downward. As of midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.27%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.06%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.17%; half-day turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 909.3 billion yuan, up 33.1 billion yuan from the previous trading day. More than 2,600 stocks in the overall market rose. On the board, the real estate sector staged a V-shaped rebound, with Lujiazui, Shenwuye A, and Zhongtian Service hitting the daily limit, while Binjiang Group, Xinda Real Estate, Shenshenfang A, China Vanke A, and China Merchants Shekou followed higher. The CRO concept led gains, with CanSino Biologics up 20CM at the daily limit, and Joinn Laboratories, Nanhua Bio, Vland Biotech, and Menovo Pharmaceutical hitting the daily limit. The grain concept rebounded, with Yalian Development hitting the daily limit, and Denghai Seeds and Wanxiang Doneed rising more than 5%. The memory chip sector, PCB concept, MLCC concept, and CPO sector were among the biggest decliners, with Aohong Electronics and Huaci Shares hitting the daily limit. Cultivated diamond board
